title: A background lane-lint run sets a time limit above the lint's own 6000 s wait
why: A lane ran `merge --lane-lint` under the background command's 30-minute default, so the lint, which waits up to 6000 s, was stopped partway and gave no verdict.
note: Filed by triage 11:36 CST Nov 10 from lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), its own mistake. Guard: refuse a background lane-lint command that sets no limit above 6000 s. Held by the freeze for a new lane; triage may build it with agents (owner 11:26 CST).
